sections.title: SYNOPSIS
sections.text: THE MID-LATITUDE WESTERLIES APPEAR LIKELY TO REMAIN LARGELY ZONAL ACROSS THE NORTHERN TIER OF THE U.S. THROUGH THIS PERIOD. WITHIN THIS REGIME...BROADER-SCALE RIDGING IS EXPECTED TO PREVAIL FROM THE NORTHERN ROCKIES INTO THE NORTH ATLANTIC SEABOARD...FLANKED BY TROUGHING OFF THE NORTH ATLANTIC COAST AND ACROSS THE NORTHERN INTERMOUNTAIN REGION. MODELS DO SUGGEST THAT SOME AMPLIFICATION OF THE TROUGHING OVER THE GREAT BASIN IS POSSIBLE...PARTICULARLY DURING THE LATTER HALF OF THE PERIOD. AS THIS OCCURS...SOME WEAKENING OF SUBTROPICAL RIDGING CENTERED NEAR/SOUTH OF 30 N LATITUDE IS POSSIBLE ACROSS NORTHERN MEXICO AND THE RIO GRANDE VALLEY...BUT THIS RIDGE IS EXPECTED TO OTHERWISE MAINTAIN STRENGTH ACROSS MUCH OF THE GULF OF MEXICO AND FLORIDA PENINSULA INTO LOWER LATITUDE WESTERN ATLANTIC. ANOTHER IN A SERIES OF SHORT WAVE PERTURBATIONS EMERGING FROM THE WESTERN U.S. MID-LATITUDE TROUGHING IS FORECAST TO RAPIDLY PROGRESS EAST NORTHEAST OF THE NORTHERN ROCKIES THROUGH NORTHWEST ONTARIO AND THE UPPER GREAT LAKES REGION. THIS MAY BE ACCOMPANIED BY THE EASTWARD MIGRATION OF A FRONTAL WAVE ALONG THE INTERNATIONAL BORDER...FROM THE NORTHERN PLAINS THIS MORNING INTO THE UPPER GREAT LAKES RE

sections.title: CENTRAL/NORTHERN PLAINS INTO UPPER MIDWEST
sections.text: COINCIDING WITH THE MID-LATITUDE IMPULSE EMERGING FROM THE NORTHERN INTERMOUNTAIN REGION...A PLUME OF VERY WARM ELEVATED MIXED-LAYER AIR IS EXPECTED TO OVERSPREAD MUCH OF THE HIGH PLAINS. WARMEST AIR IN THE 850-700 MB LAYER IS EXPECTED ALONG AN AXIS FROM THE TEXAS BIG BEND REGION NORTHWARD INTO CENTRAL SOUTH DAKOTA BY 12Z TODAY. WHILE WARMING OCCURS ACROSS MUCH OF THE REMAINDER OF THE SOUTHERN AND CENTRAL PLAINS...THE NORTHEASTERN PERIPHERY OF THIS AIR MASS MAY CONTINUE TO ADVECT NORTHEASTWARD TOWARD THE UPPER MISSISSIPPI VALLEY DURING THE DAY...BEFORE BECOMING SUPPRESSED BY THE CONTINUED EASTWARD PROGRESSION OF THE UPPER IMPULSE. THE STRONGER THERMAL GRADIENT DELINEATING THE LEADING/NORTHERN EDGE OF THIS AIR MASS APPEARS TO PROVIDE ONE PROBABLE FOCUS FOR CONVECTIVE DEVELOPMENT TODAY...AS SEASONABLY HIGH BOUNDARY LAYER MOISTURE CONTENT ATTEMPTS TO ADVECT NORTHWARD FROM THE CENTRAL PLAINS/LOWER MISSOURI VALLEY REGION. THIS MOISTURE...BENEATH THE STEEPER MID-LEVEL LAPSE RATE AIR...IS EXPECTED TO CONTRIBUTE TO SIZABLE MIXED-LAYER CAPE OF 2000-3000+ J/KG...EAST OF A PRE-FRONTAL SURFACE TROUGH ACROSS THE CENTRAL PLAINS...INTO THE VICINITY OF A THERMAL LOW OVER EASTERN SOUTH DAKOTA BY LA

THE AIRMASS ACROSS MUCH OF THIS REGION IS MODERATELY TO STRONGLY UNSTABLE AS SFC TEMPERATURES HAVE WARMED INTO THE UPPER 80S TO MID 90S WITH STRONG DIURNAL HEATING. A MOIST LOW-LEVEL AIRMASS ALSO REMAINS IN PLACE...WITH SFC DEWPOINTS GENERALLY IN THE LOWER TO MID 70S. LATEST RAP MESOANALSIS SUGGESTS RESULTANT MLCAPE RANGES FROM 1000 J/KG ACROSS THE WRN CAROLINAS TO NEAR 3000 J/KG FURTHER E. THIS REGION CURRENTLY LIES ON THE SRN FRINGE OF STRONGER WLY FLOW ALOFT...WITH AREA VWPS ESTIMATING WEAK SWLY LOW-LEVEL FLOW VEERS TO WLY AND STRENGTHENS TO AROUND 30-35 KT AT 6 KM. EFFECTIVE BULK SHEAR VALUES OF 25-35 KT MAY ALLOW CONVECTION FORMING IN WRN NC TO BECOME ORGANIZED/FORWARD PROPAGATING...WITH A STRONG TO LOCALLY DAMAGING WIND THREAT. LATEST VISIBLE SATELLITE IMAGERY BUILDING CU ALONG THE NC/VA BORDER...AND IT IS POSSIBLE THAT MORE THAN ONE CONVECTIVE CLUSTER COULD DEVELOP.

LATEST VIS IMAGERY SUGGESTS BOUNDARY-LAYER CU FIELD IS EXPANDING ALONG THIS WIND SHIFT...DRAPED FROM CNTRL MN...WSWWD INTO ERN SD...WEST OF ATY OVER CLARK COUNTY. EXTREME BUOYANCY ALONG WITH SFC-6KM BULK SHEAR ON THE ORDER OF 40KT FAVORS SUPERCELL STRUCTURES ALONG THIS CORRIDOR. TORNADO WATCH WILL BE ISSUED SOON AS THIS ACTIVITY IS EXPECTED TO MATURE AND PROPAGATE EWD ACROSS MN TOWARD THE MS RIVER LATER THIS AFTERNOON/EVENING.

DAMAGING WINDS AND LARGE HAIL CAN BE EXPECTED WITH SEVERE TSTMS AS THEY PROPAGATE SEWD.

mesoscale_discussions.discussion: AN ISOLATED THUNDERSTORM HAS DEVELOPED OVER THE PAST HOUR IN BORDEN COUNTY TX ALONG AN OUTFLOW BOUNDARY FROM EARLIER CONVECTION. ADDITIONAL CONVECTION IS DEVELOPING FURTHER W ALONG THE TX/NM BORDER AS OF 20Z. SFC TEMPERATURES HAVE WARMED INTO THE UPPER 90S TO LOWER 100S ACROSS MOST OF THE MCD AREA ALONG/W OF THE OUTFLOW BOUNDARY. WITH TEMPERATURE/DEWPOINT SPREADS APPROACHING 50 DEG F AND STEEP LOW TO MID-LEVEL LAPSE RATES PRESENT...CONVECTIVE DOWNDRAFT POTENTIAL WILL BE MAXIMIZED THROUGH THE EARLY EVENING. ISOLATED LARGE HAIL MAY ALSO OCCUR INITIALLY GIVEN A STRONGLY UNSTABLE AIRMASS...SUFFICIENT EFFECTIVE BULK SHEAR VALUES...AND FAVORABLE/ISOLATED STORM MODE. THERE IS SOME POTENTIAL FOR UPSCALE GROWTH INTO A SMALL MCS/CLUSTER MOVING SLOWLY SEWD OVER THE NEXT SEVERAL HOURS AS ADDITIONAL CONVECTION DEVELOPS ALONG THE OUTFLOW BOUNDARY. IF IT DEVELOPS...THIS ACTIVITY WOULD HAVE MAINLY A STRONG TO LOCALLY DAMAGING WIND RISK. REGARDLESS...THE OVERALL SEVERE THREAT IS EXPECTED TO REMAIN RATHER ISOLATED...AND WW ISSUANCE IS UNLIKELY AT THIS TIME.

mesoscale_discussions.summary: ISOLATED SEVERE THUNDERSTORMS CAPABLE OF PRODUCING DAMAGING WINDS AND LARGE HAIL ARE EXPECTED ACROSS PORTIONS OF NWRN KS INTO SCNTRL NEBRASKA.
mesoscale_discussions.discussion: STRONG SFC HEATING HAS CONTRIBUTED TO A DEEP...WELL-MIXED BOUNDARY LAYER ACROSS THE CNTRL HIGH PLAINS THIS AFTERNOON. CONVECTION IS INTENSIFYING ALONG A WIND SHIFT WHERE SFC TEMPERATURES HAVE WARMED TO NEAR 100F. ROBUST THUNDERSTORMS APPEAR LIKELY ALONG A CORRIDOR FROM EAST OF GLD TO NEAR EAR BEFORE PROPAGATING SEWD INTO THE EARLY EVENING HOURS. GIVEN THE 40-50F SUB-CLOUD TEMP/DEW POINT SPREADS...DAMAGING DOWNBURSTS APPEAR POSSIBLE.

mesoscale_discussions.summary: THE AREA IS BEING MONITORED FOR POSSIBLE UPSCALE-GROWING CONVECTIVE CLUSTERS AND MCS DEVELOPMENT...POTENTIALLY YIELDING AN INCREASE IN THE SVR-WIND RISK. THE ISSUANCE OF A SVR TSTM WATCH IS POSSIBLE THROUGH THIS EVENING.
mesoscale_discussions.discussion: CONVECTION CONTINUES TO DEVELOP ACROSS FAR SRN NEB AND FAR NRN KS IN PROXIMITY TO A WIND-SHIFT AXIS/WEAK FRONT ANALYZED FROM E OF LEXINGTON NEB TO NE OF COLBY KS. ADDITIONALLY...HIGH-BASED CONVECTION CONTINUES SPREADING EWD ACROSS PARTS OF THE HIGH PLAINS OF SERN WY/NERN CO/NEB PANHANDLE. THIS LATTER ACTIVITY IS ASSOCIATED WITH ASCENT RELATED TO A MID-LEVEL SPEED MAX GLANCING MODEST BUOYANCY N OF THE WIND-SHIFT AXIS...AND HAS BEEN PRODUCING OBSERVED SFC WIND GUSTS AROUND 35-40 KT. BOTH AREAS OF CONVECTION HAVE SHOWN SIGNS OF LOOSELY ORGANIZED CLUSTERING. IT IS POSSIBLE THAT INCREASING COLD POOL CONSOLIDATION IN THE HIGH-DCAPE ENVIRONMENT MAY GIVE RISE TO THE DEVELOPMENT OF ONE OR TWO SEVERE MCS/S DURING THE NEXT FEW HOURS. THIS COULD ESPECIALLY BE THE CASE AS STRONGER ASCENT/DEEP SHEAR RELATED TO THE WRN CONVECTION FOSTERS MORE SUSTAINED/ORGANIZED INTERACTING UPDRAFTS IN THE UPSLOPE-FLOW REGIME...THAT COULD EVENTUALLY INTERCEPT RICHER LOW-LEVEL MOISTURE WITH EWD EXTENT ACROSS SRN NEB/NRN KS AND VICINITY. AT THE SAME TIME...THE EASTERN CONVECTIVE CLUSTER MAY ALSO GROW UPSCALE AMIDST GREATER BUOYANCY IN S-CNTRL NEB AND N-CNTRL KS. AN INCREASING LLJ THIS EVENING MAY SUSTAIN CONVECTIVE CLUSTERS AND RELATED SVR-WIND POTENTIAL. OVERALL...UNCERTAINTY DOES EXIST REGARDING PROSPECTS FOR UPSCALE GROWTH OF ONGOING CONVECTIVE CLUSTERS. STRONG DEEP SHEAR/ASCENT IS SOMEWHAT REMOVED TO THE NW OF RICHER BUOYANCY FOCUSED ALONG/S AND SE OF THE WIND-SHIFT AXIS. FURTHERMORE...DEEP SHEAR IS NOT PARTICULARLY STRONG...AND THIS RESULTS IN RESERVATIONS REGARDING CONFIDENCE IN ANY SUBSTANTIAL UPSCALE CONVECTIVE GROWTH. NEVERTHELESS...THE STEEP MID-LEVEL LAPSE-RATE ENVIRONMENT SUPPORTING SUFFICIENT BUOYANCY AMIDST SUFFICIENT DEEP SHEAR RESULTS IN SOME CONSIDERATION FOR AT LEAST ISOLATED SVR POTEN

mesoscale_discussions.summary: ALL SEVERE HAZARDS REMAIN POSSIBLE ACROSS TORNADO WATCH 323.
mesoscale_discussions.discussion: REGIONAL RADAR DATA SHOWS TWO SUPERCELLS ACROSS CNTRL MN AND TWO OTHERS FARTHER W ACROSS E-CNTRL SD. CONVECTION IS INITIATING ALONG THE COLD FRONT EXTENDING BETWEEN THESE TWO AREAS...WITH POTENTIAL FOR THIS ENTIRE AREA TO EVOLVE INTO A LINEAR CONVECTIVE SYSTEM DURING THE NEXT FEW HOURS AS SWLY LOW-LEVEL FLOW GRADUALLY INCREASES. THREAT FOR ALL SEVERE HAZARDS...INCLUDING VERY LARGE HAIL /GREATER THAN 2 INCHES/...SIGNIFICANT WIND GUSTS /GREATER THAN 74 MPH/...AND A FEW TORNADOES REMAINS ACROSS TORNADO WATCH 323. CURRENT STORM MOTION OF THE SUPERCELL MOVING THROUGH WRIGHT COUNTY MN IS ESTIMATED TO BE SELY AT 37 KT. THIS TAKES THIS STORM THE WRN PORTIONS OF THE MINNEAPOLIS/ST. PAUL METRO AREA WITHIN THE NEXT 30 MIN /AROUND 2230Z/. STRONG WIND SIGNATURE ON RADAR SUGGESTS SOME SIGNIFICANT DAMAGING WIND GUSTS ARE POSSIBLE. ..MOSIER.. 07/05/2016 ...PLEASE SEE WWW.SPC.NOAA.GOV FOR GRAPHIC PRODUCT...

mesoscale_discussions.summary: A SMALL CONVECTIVE CLUSTER WILL CONTINUE TRACKING ACROSS PORTIONS OF NERN MN AND COULD PRODUCE SPORADIC SVR WIND GUSTS. THE ISSUANCE OF A WW IS UNLIKELY.
mesoscale_discussions.discussion: A SMALL CONVECTIVE CLUSTER THAT DEVELOPED WITHIN A LOBE OF ASCENT PRECEDING A LOW-AMPLITUDE SHORTWAVE TROUGH ACROSS N-CNTRL MN WILL CONTINUE SPREADING EWD TOWARD/ACROSS THE MN ARROWHEAD INTO THE EARLY EVENING. THE ENVIRONMENT AHEAD OF THIS ACTIVITY IS MODESTLY UNSTABLE...AIDED BY DIURNALLY STEEPENED LOW-LEVEL LAPSE RATES. HOWEVER...SFC DEWPOINTS REFLECT ONLY MODEST LOW-LEVEL MOISTURE IN PLACE...WITH DEWPOINTS PRIMARILY IN THE MIDDLE/UPPER 50S AND MLCAPE IS RESTRICTED TO AROUND 500-1500 J/KG. REGARDLESS...THE DLH VWP SAMPLES DEEP AND MODERATE...LARGELY UNIDIRECTIONAL WSWLY/WLY WINDS THROUGH THE CONVECTIVE LAYER THAT WILL CONTINUE FACILITATING A FAST...EWD-SPREADING CONVECTIVE CLUSTER WITH LOCALLY SVR WIND GUSTS POSSIBLE. HOWEVER...THE LACK OF STRONGER BUOYANCY WILL TEND TO MARGINALIZE THE OVERALL SVR RISK...WITH THIS RISK POTENTIALLY WEAKENING AS IT MOVES INTO MORE STABLE AIR E OF A WWD SPREADING LAKE-SUPERIOR LAKE-BREEZE BOUNDARY W OF THE LAKE SUPERIOR SHORELINE.

mesoscale_discussions.summary: CONVECTIVE CLUSTERS SPREADING EWD TOWARD/ACROSS THE NC/SC COASTAL PLAIN WILL HAVE THE POTENTIAL TO PRODUCE AT LEAST ISOLATED SVR WIND GUSTS THROUGH EARLY EVENING. THE ISSUANCE OF A SVR TSTM WATCH IS POSSIBLE EWD TO THE ATLANTIC COAST.
mesoscale_discussions.discussion: CONVECTIVE CLUSTERS HAVE LOOSELY CONGEALED FROM THE PIEDMONT OF NC TO SC AND ARE SPREADING EWD. THE AIR MASS TO THE EAST OF THIS ACTIVITY FEATURES AROUND 2000-3000 J/KG OF MLCAPE AIDED BY STRONG SFC HEATING AMIDST RICH LOW-LEVEL MOISTURE CHARACTERIZED BY SFC DEWPOINTS IN THE 70S. WITH ANTECEDENT STEEP LOW-LEVEL LAPSE RATES IN PLACE...A LOOSELY ORGANIZED CONVECTIVE MODE...AND PW AROUND 1.75 INCHES SUGGESTING AMPLE WATER LOADING TO ENHANCE DOWNDRAFTS...AT LEAST ISOLATED SVR WIND GUSTS WILL BE POSSIBLE EWD TO THE ATLANTIC COAST. DEEP SHEAR IS STRONGEST -- ALBEIT MODEST IN MAGNITUDE AROUND 25-30 KT -- ACROSS NC...WITH WEAKER SHEAR FARTHER S...AND THIS MAY TEND TO LIMIT THE OVERALL COVERAGE OF SVR WIND GUSTS. REGARDLESS...SUFFICIENT CONVECTIVE ORGANIZATION MAY BE UNDERWAY TO SUPPORT THE POTENTIAL FOR ISOLATED DMGG WIND GUSTS TO ACCOMPANY CONVECTION DURING THE NEXT FEW HOURS.

mesoscale_discussions.summary: THE RISK FOR SVR TSTMS WITH DMGG WINDS AND LARGE HAIL CONTINUES ACROSS WW 328. AREAS TO THE E IN ERN NEB...AND S IN OTHER PARTS OF WRN/CNTRL KS ARE BEING MONITORED FOR POSSIBLE ISSUANCE OF NEW WW/S -- 40 PERCENT PROBABILITY IN EACH OF THESE AREAS.
mesoscale_discussions.discussion: ONGOING CONVECTIVE CLUSTERS CONTINUE EVOLVING EARLY THIS EVENING ACROSS WW 328. ONE SUSTAINED TSTM CLUSTER IS DEVELOPING SWD BETWEEN COLBY AND HILL CITY KS...IN PROXIMITY TO THE THE SWD-ADVANCING INTERSECTION POINT BETWEEN A W/E CONVECTIVE OUTFLOW BOUNDARY AND N/S LEE TROUGH. THIS ACTIVITY MAY CONTINUE TO PREFERENTIALLY DEVELOP SWD/SEWD INTO MOIST/UNSTABLE AIR ACROSS PARTS OF CNTRL/WRN KS. THE DDC 00Z RAOB SAMPLED AROUND 3000 J/KG OF MLCAPE WITH LITTLE MLCINH AND AROUND 35 KT OF EFFECTIVE BULK SHEAR IN SUPPORT OF SUSTAINED/ORGANIZED CONVECTION. A NOCTURNALLY STRENGTHENING LLJ MAY ALSO FOCUS CONVECTIVE PROPAGATION SWD ACROSS PARTS OF WRN/CNTRL KS THROUGH THE EVENING HOURS...WITH STEEP LOW/MID-LEVEL LAPSE RATES AND RELATED LARGE BUOYANCY SUSTAINING A SVR RISK INTO THE EVENING HOURS. THIS COULD WARRANT LOCAL EXTENSION OF THE WW AND/OR NEW WW ISSUANCE LATER THIS EVENING. FARTHER E ACROSS ERN PARTS OF S-CNTRL NEB...LOOSELY ORGANIZING CONVECTIVE CLUSTERS ARE BEING FED BY AMPLE INSTABILITY SAMPLED BY THE 00Z TOP RAOB. AS COLD POOLS CONTINUE TO DEVELOP AND EXPAND...AND AS REAR INFLOW POTENTIALLY BECOMES FACILITATED AMIDST INTERACTING CONVECTIVE ELEMENTS...IT IS POSSIBLE THAT CONVECTION AND THE ASSOCIATED SVR-WIND/HAIL RISK COULD EXTEND E OF WW 328 INTO PARTS OF ERN NEB -- WARRANTING NEW WW ISSUANCE. ULTIMATELY...LARGE-SCALE FORCING FOR ASCENT IS RELATIVELY MODEST...AND THE SVR RISK OUTSIDE OF WW 328 IS SOMEWHAT UNCERTAIN. HOWEVER...THE POTENTIAL FOR ONE OR TWO MCS/S TO EVOLVE IN THE NEXT FEW HOURS EXISTS AS A LLJ STRENGTHENS. RELATED SVR POTENTIAL MAY EXTEND OUTSIDE OF THE WW ACROSS PARTS OF CNTRL/WRN KS AND ERN NEB.

mesoscale_discussions.summary: SVR THREAT CONTINUES ACROSS TORNADO WATCH 323 AND SEVERE THUNDERSTORM WATCHES 324 AND 326. MCS HAS ORGANIZED ACROSS SRN MN AND THE PRIMARY SVR THREAT IS DAMAGING WIND GUSTS.
mesoscale_discussions.discussion: RADAR DEPICTION OF THE LEAD SUPERCELL...CURRENTLY MOVING INTO ST. CROIX AND PIERCE COUNTIES IN FAR W-CNTRL WI...HAS SHOWN CYCLIC TIGHTENING OF THE LOW-LEVEL CIRCULATION OVER THE PAST HOUR WITH PERSISTENCE AREAS OF STRONG REAR FLANK DOWNDRAFT. SOME CLEARING IS ALSO NOTED ON THE REFLECTIVITY IN THE WAKE OF THIS STORM ACROSS THE MINNEAPOLIS/ST. PAUL METRO...WHICH IN TANDEM WITH THE SURFACE OBSERVATIONS IS SUGGESTIVE OF SOME TYPE OF INCREASING REAR-INFLOW/WAKE LOW. NELY SURFACE WINDS SUGGEST THE LOW IN THIS CASE IS LIKELY THE BOOK-END VORTEX DEVELOPING ALONG THE ERN EDGE OF A CONVECTIVE LINE EXTENDING FROM CARVER AND SCOTT COUNTIES WWD TO REDWOOD AND BROWN COUNTIES. RADAR SIGNATURE OF THIS CONVECTIVE LINE HAS RECENTLY SHOWN INCREASED FORWARD PROPAGATION. THIS REFLECTIVITY SURGE COUPLE WITH THE STRONG INDICATIONS OF A BOOK-END VORTEX SUGGEST THE SYSTEM IS WELL-ORGANIZED. DOWNSTREAM AIRMASS IS VERY MOIST /DEWPOINTS IN THE LOW TO MID 70S/...WHICH WHEN COUPLED WITH STEEP MID-LEVEL LAPSE RATES /ABOVE 7.5 DEG C PER KM BASED ON RECENT MESOANALYSIS AND REGIONAL RAOBS/ ARE SUPPORTING STRONG TO EXTREME INSTABILITY /MLCAPE ABOVE 3000 J PER KG/. BETTER SHEAR IS DISPLACED A BIT N OF THIS REGION BUT 40-50 KT EFFECTIVE BULK SHEAR IS MORE THAN SUFFICIENT FOR CONTINUED STORM ORGANIZATION. ADDITIONALLY...A STRENGTHENING LLJ INTO THE BAROCLINIC ZONE ACROSS THE REGION WILL PROVIDE ADDITIONAL SUPPORT FOR MCS MAINTENANCE. ..MOSIER.. 07/06/2016 ...PLEASE SEE WWW.SPC.NOAA.GOV FOR GRAPHIC PRODUCT...

mesoscale_discussions.summary: THE RISK FOR LOCALLY STRONG WIND GUSTS CONTINUES ACROSS REMAINING-VALID PORTIONS OF WW 327 IN ASSOCIATION WITH A SQUALL LINE SPREADING EWD.
mesoscale_discussions.discussion: DIURNALLY ENHANCED CONVECTION HAS CONGEALED INTO A SQUALL LINE SPREADING EWD ACROSS PORTIONS OF THE NC COASTAL PLAIN. THE AIR MASS TO THE E OF THIS ACTIVITY FEATURES SUFFICIENT BUOYANCY FOR CONVECTION WITH LOCALLY STRONG WINDS TO BE MAINTAINED TO THE ATLANTIC COAST...AS DEWPOINTS REMAIN IN THE 70S. AMPLE WATER LOADING ASSOCIATED WITH PW AROUND 2 INCHES PER GPS IMAGERY MAY CONTRIBUTE TO DOWNDRAFT ACCELERATIONS CAPABLE OF ISOLATED DMGG WIND GUSTS. ANY SVR POTENTIAL WILL DECREASE TO NIL FOLLOWING THE PASSAGE OF THE SQUALL LINE OWING TO CONVECTIVE PROCESSING OF THE ANTECEDENT BUOYANCY. ..COHEN.. 07/06/2016 ...PLEASE SEE WWW.SPC.NOAA.GOV FOR GRAPHIC PRODUCT...

mesoscale_discussions.summary: A DOWNSTREAM WATCH WILL LIKELY BE NEEDED BEFORE 03Z ACROSS PORTIONS OF CNTRL/SW WI...NE IA...AND NW IL AS THE ONGOING MCS CONTINUES SEWD INTO THE REGION.
mesoscale_discussions.discussion: STORM MOTION OF THE ONGOING MCS IS ESTIMATED AT 300/38 KT...TAKING IT TO THE EDGE OF THE SEVERE THUNDERSTORM WATCH 326 AROUND 0230-0300Z. REGIONAL VADS SHOW INCREASING SWLY LOW-LEVEL FLOW INTO THE WARM FRONTAL ZONE STRETCHING FROM FAR SE MN SEWD INTO NW IL. ADDITIONAL LIFT PROVIDE BY THIS INCREASING WAA AS WELL AS THE ORGANIZED NATURE OF THE ONGOING MCS AND THE MORE THAN SUFFICIENT INSTABILITY SUGGEST THE SYSTEM WILL MAINTAIN ITS STRENGTH AS IT TRACKS INTO PORTIONS OF CNTRL/SW WI...NE IA...AND NW IL. PRIMARY THREAT WILL BE DAMAGING WIND GUSTS WITH HAIL AS THE SECONDARY THREAT. SOME TORNADO THREAT WILL ALSO EXISTS GIVEN THE PRESENCE OF THE BOUNDARY AND MOIST NATURE OF THE LOW-LEVEL AIRMASS.

mesoscale_discussions.summary: CONVECTION IS FORECAST TO SPREAD EWD ACROSS THE UPPER PENINSULA OF MI AND PERHAPS ADJACENT NRN WI DURING THE NEXT SEVERAL HOURS...AND AT LEAST ISOLATED SVR HAIL/WIND MAY OCCUR. IT IS POSSIBLE THAT A WW MAY BE NEEDED.
mesoscale_discussions.discussion: ISOLATED CONVECTION IN ASSOCIATION WITH MODEST LARGE-SCALE ASCENT PRECEDING A LOW-AMPLITUDE MID-LEVEL CYCLONIC PERTURBATION IS INCREASING OVER FAR WRN UPPER MI AND WRN LAKE SUPERIOR. ISENTROPIC ASCENT NEAR/N OF A WAVY SFC BOUNDARY ANALYZED W/E ACROSS THE UPPER PENINSULA MAY ALSO BE ENCOURAGING THE DEVELOPMENT OF THIS ACTIVITY...AS THE MQT VWP INDICATES VERTICALLY VEERING WEAK LOW-LEVEL FLOW IN THE LOWEST 2 KM AGL. IT IS POSSIBLE THAT ADDITIONAL CONVECTION MAY DEVELOP AND SPREAD EWD THROUGH THE EVENING AND INTO THE EARLY OVERNIGHT HOURS. WITH DEWPOINTS IN THE LOWER/MIDDLE 60S NEAR AND S OF THE BOUNDARY YIELDING MODERATE BUOYANCY...AND THE UPSTREAM INTERNATIONAL FALLS 00Z RAOB SAMPLING 50-70 KT OF MID-LEVEL FLOW THAT WILL OVERSPREAD THE AREA AND FACILITATE STRONG DEEP SHEAR...ORGANIZED CONVECTIVE CLUSTERS WITH AT LEAST ISOLATED SVR HAIL/WIND MAY OCCUR. HOWEVER...WEAK LOW-LEVEL FLOW/CONVERGENCE...MODEST LARGE-SCALE ASCENT...ALONG WITH NOCTURNAL STABILIZATION MAY ALL MITIGATE SVR COVERAGE. FURTHERMORE...AN INFLUX OF PRECIPITATION-COOLED AIR FROM THE N SIDE OF THE STRATIFORM PRECIPITATION AREA ACCOMPANYING AN MCS FARTHER S/SW COULD ALSO BE DETRIMENTAL TO THE SVR RISK. REGARDLESS...THE AREA WILL CONTINUE TO BE MONITORED FOR POSSIBLE WW ISSUANCE.

mesoscale_discussions.summary: TSTM COMPLEX ACROSS E-CNTRL NEB WILL CONTINUE TO POSE AN ISOLATED WIND/HAIL THREAT AS IT MOVES NEWD. OTHER TSTMS MAY FILL IN ACROSS CNTRL IA AND TRENDS WILL BE MONITORED HERE FOR A POTENTIAL WW.
mesoscale_discussions.discussion: RECENT RADAR IMAGERY HAS SHOWN THE TSTM COMPLEX MOVING ACROSS E-CNTRL NEB HAS BECOMING INCREASINGLY OUTFLOW DOMINANT AND THAT THE OVERALL STORM STRENGTH HAS DIMINISHED SLIGHTLY. HOWEVER...TQE -- ALONG THE NEB/IA BORDER -- RECENT REPORTED A 57 KT GUST AND THE DOWNSTREAM REMAINS VERY UNSTABLE. EXPECTATION IS FOR THE COMPLEX TO CONTINUE NEWD AS IT GRADUALLY BECOMES MORE LINEAR...WITH SOME ADDITIONAL DEVELOPMENT POSSIBLE AS THE OUTFLOW INTERACTS WITH THE BAROCLINIC ZONE STRETCHING ACROSS FROM NW/W-CNTRL IA NEWD TOWARDS THE BOWING LINE ACROSS SE MN AND WAA CONTINUES. THERE IS SOME CHANCE DEVELOPMENT BETWEEN THESE SYSTEMS CONSOLIDATES INTO A SINGULAR LINE AS IT MOVES ACROSS IA. SOME LOCALIZED HAIL AND WIND IS POSSIBLE AND TRENDS ACROSS THE REGION WILL BE MONITORED FOR A POTENTIAL WATCH. WATCH PROBABILITY IS 60-PERCENT.

mesoscale_discussions.summary: WIDESPREAD DAMAGING WIND GUSTS...AND PERHAPS A BRIEF TORNADO OR TWO...ARE EXPECTED OVERNIGHT AS A WELL-DEVELOPED MCS MOVES ACROSS CNTRL/SRN WI AT 40-50 KT.
mesoscale_discussions.discussion: WELL-DEVELOPED BOWING MCS CONTINUES SEWD ACROSS SRN/CNTRL WI AND NE IA. CURRENT STORM MOTION OF THE NRN PORTION OF THE BOW IS ESTIMATED AT 290 DEGREES AT 40-50 KT. BASED ON RADAR IMAGERY...THE BOOKEND VORTEX ASSOCIATED WITH THIS SYSTEM LOOKS TO BE JUST NE OF LSE...ACROSS JACKSON AND MONROE COUNTIES. PORTION OF THE MCS JUST SW OF BOOKEND VORTEX SHOWS THE STRONGEST OUTBOUND VELOCITIES WITH SEVERAL MESOVORTICIES EMBEDDED WITHIN THE LINE. SURFACE OBSERVATIONS REVEAL A SURFACE BOUNDARY ACROSS SRN MN...DELINEATED BEST BY THE SUBTLE WIND SHIFT. THE STRONGEST MESOVORTEX OVER VERNON COUNTY WI APPEARS TO BE INTERACTING WITH THIS BOUNDARY. THREAT FOR WIDESPREAD DAMAGING WIND GUSTS AND PERHAPS A BRIEF TORNADO WILL CONTINUE ACROSS THE REGION OVERNIGHT. ..MOSIER.. 07/06/2016 ...PLEASE SEE WWW.SPC.NOAA.GOV FOR GRAPHIC PRODUCT...

mesoscale_discussions.summary: THE SVR-TSTM RISK IS SPREADING SWD/SEWD ACROSS PORTIONS OF WRN/CNTRL KS...AND THE SVR RISK SHOULD SPREAD FARTHER S -- PERHAPS AS FAR SOUTH AS NRN OK -- DURING THE OVERNIGHT HOURS.
mesoscale_discussions.discussion: CONGEALING CONVECTIVE CLUSTERS OVER PARTS OF WRN KS HAVE EVOLVED INTO A MORE ORGANIZED SYSTEM SURGING SWD IN PARTS OF NESS AND LANE COUNTIES KS. THIS IS CONSISTENT WITH THE NOCTURNAL INCREASE IN LOW-LEVEL SLYS DRIVING CONVECTIVE PROPAGATION SWD INTO THE STRENGTHENING LLJ. THE DDC VWP INDICATES 0.5-KM-AGL SLY FLOW HAVING INCREASED FROM 20 TO 30 KT DURING THE PAST FEW HOURS...RESULTING IN STRENGTHENING INFLOW FOR THE ONGOING CONVECTION. FURTHER STRENGTHENING OF THE NOCTURNAL BOUNDARY-LAYER WIND-SPEED MAXIMUM SHOULD FOSTER STRENGTHENING INFLOW ON THE SRN FLANK OF THE ONGOING CONVECTION DURING THE OVERNIGHT HOURS...WHILE WLY/NWLY MID-LEVEL FLOW YIELDS EWD/SEWD CELL ADVECTION. AS A RESULT...LOCALLY UPSCALE-GROWING CONVECTIVE CLUSTERS WILL CONTINUE SPREADING SWD/SEWD DURING THE NEXT SEVERAL HOURS. THE EARLIER 00Z DDC RAOB SUGGESTS THAT AMPLE BUOYANCY WILL EMANATE FROM BASE OF THE RESIDUAL MIXED LAYER...WITH MUCAPE ON THE ORDER OF 3000-4000 J/KG FOSTERING INTENSE UPDRAFTS AMIDST 35-50 KT OF EFFECTIVE BULK SHEAR. THIS WILL ALLOW SOME SVR RISK TO EXTEND S OF WW 330 INTO THE OVERNIGHT HOURS...AND LOCAL EXTENSION OF THE WW MAY BE NEEDED. FURTHERMORE...SOME ISOLATED SVR RISK CANNOT BE RULED OUT AS FAR S AS NRN OK LATER TONIGHT AS THE LLJ ENHANCES INFLOW. HOWEVER...GROWING NOCTURNAL MLCINH MAY BE DETRIMENTAL TO DOWNDRAFTS PENETRATING THE SFC-BASED NOCTURNAL STABLE LAYER. AS SUCH...THE ISSUANCE OF AN ENTIRELY NEW WW IS UNLIKELY. OTHER ISOLATED INTENSE CONVECTION CONTINUES DEVELOPING ACROSS PARTS OF N-CNTRL KS AT THE TERMINUS OF THE STRENGTHENING LLJ. IT IS POSSIBLE THAT THIS ACTIVITY MAY SUPPORT AN ISOLATED SVR RISK AS IT SPREADS ACROSS PARTS OF CNTRL/NRN KS. FARTHER N INTO FAR SRN NEB...THE SVR RISK ACROSS REMAINING-VALID PORTIONS OF WW 328 HAS LARGELY DIMINISHED OWING TO STABILIZAT

mesoscale_discussions.summary: ALTHOUGH OVERALL SEVERE POTENTIAL WITH ONGOING CONVECTIVE SYSTEMS MAY RAMP DOWN GRADUALLY THROUGH PRE-DAWN HOURS...WE EXPECT DAMAGING-WIND RISK TO PERSIST LONG AND FAR ENOUGH OUT OF EXISTING WATCH AREAS THAT A NEW WATCH IS LIKELY TO BE NEEDED IN SHORTER TERM...PRIMARILY S OF WW 331.
mesoscale_discussions.discussion: LEADING/LARGEST MCS WAS EVIDENT AT 0615Z ALONG ARC EXTENDING NEAR GRB...JVL...WTI. THIS COMPLEX HAS BEEN DECAYING FROM N-S AS IT ENCOUNTERS PROGRESSIVELY MORE STABLE BOUNDARY-LAYER AIR RELATED TO COMBINATION OF BOTH NOCTURNAL/DIABATIC SFC COOLING AND WRN FRINGES OF MARINE-LAYER SEEPAGE FROM LM. THIS PROCESS SHOULD CONTINUE...CAUSING CONTINUED EROSION OF DEEPEST/HIGH-REFLECTIVITY STRUCTURES SWD INVOF LAKESHORE...AND CORRESPONDING N-S-DIRECTED WARMING OF IR CLOUD TOPS ALREADY NOTED OVER ERN WI. STILL...STG PRESSURE/THETAE PERTURBATIONS ASSOCIATED WITH THIS COMPLEX MAY FORCE AT LEAST MRGL SVR POTENTIAL ONTO SWRN PORTIONS OF LAKESHORE ACROSS WI/IL...AND ADJOINING PARTS OF LM. GIVEN THIS FACTOR...WW 331 HAS BEEN EXTENDED TO IMMEDIATE SHORELINE AREA IN WI. REMAINDER OF MCS SHOULD PUSH SEWD INTO MORE OF NRN AND EVENTUALLY CENTRAL IL. PROSPECTIVE INFLOW-LAYER AIR MASS IS CHARACTERIZED BY RICH LOW-LEVEL MOISTURE THAT IS KEEPING PACE SLOW FOR DIABATIC SFC COOLING...WITH MUCAPE RANGING FROM 1000 J/KG IN CHICAGOLAND AREA TO OVER 4000 J/KG OVER SERN IA/NWRN IL. OUTFLOW BOUNDARY FROM LEADING MCS TRAILS SWWD/WWD ACROSS CENTRAL IA NE OF DSM...WHERE IT IS BEING OVERTAKEN BY LONG-LIVED..SMALLER BUT STILL STG/SVR TSTM COMPLEX WITH HISTORY OF DAMAGING WINDS. THAT MCS IS EXPECTED TO FOCUS PREFERENTIALLY INTO OPTIMAL THETAE ALONG AND S OF STILL-PROGRESSIVE OUTFLOW BOUNDARY THAT WILL REORIENT WNW-ESE WITH TIME. ALTHOUGH WW 331 HAS BEEN EXTENDED S OVER PARTS OF SERN IA TO COVER SHORT-FUSED THREAT...ASSOCIATED LIFT/CONVERGENCE AND PROPAGATION SHOULD REDIRECT ASSOCIATED SVR POTENTIAL STILL FARTHER SEWD INTO PORTIONS SERN IA/NWRN IL NOT PRESENTLY IN WWS. ..EDWARDS.. 07/06/2016 ...PLEASE SEE WWW.SPC.NOAA.GOV FOR GRAPHIC PRODUCT...

mesoscale_discussions.summary: A NEW SEVERE TSTM WATCH WILL BE COORDINATED SHORTLY FOR EASTERN KS AND PERHAPS PARTS OF FAR NORTH-CENTRAL AND NORTHEAST OK.
mesoscale_discussions.discussion: TWO EAST-SOUTHEASTWARD-MOVING BANDS OF STORMS WERE LOCATED IN CENTRAL KS...EACH WITH THEIR OWN REAR-INFLOW JETS. THESE JETS ARE DEPICTED BY THE INDIVIDUAL BOWING STRUCTURES OF EACH BAND OF STORMS AND THE FORMATION OF A WNW-ESE CONVERGENCE ZONE FROM BARTON TO GOVE COUNTIES KS BETWEEN THESE JETS. A STRENGTHENING SWLY LLJ /40-45 KT/ FROM OK INTO THESE STORM COMPLEXES AND RESIDUAL RESERVOIR OF DOWNSTREAM MODERATE-VERY STRONG INSTABILITY SUGGEST THESE FACTORS WILL SUPPORT A CONTINUED THREAT FOR SEVERE WIND GUSTS THROUGH 10-12Z. THE TRACK OF THESE BANDS BRINGS THE SEVERE THREAT INTO FAR SOUTHWEST MO BY 10Z AND INTO NORTH-CENTRAL OR NORTHEAST OK NEAR THAT SAME TIME.

mesoscale_discussions.summary: LOCAL TEMPORAL EXTENSION MAY BE NEEDED FOR THE SOUTHERN HALF OF WW 330...GIVEN THE PRESENCE OF PERSISTENT AND STRONG STORMS PROPAGATING SOUTHWARD. DAMAGING WINDS AND HAIL ARE THE PRIMARY THREATS.
mesoscale_discussions.discussion: THE WNW-ESE ORIENTED CONVERGENCE ZONE...LIKELY ASSOCIATED WITH TWO REAR-INFLOW JETS ATTENDANT TO THE BAND OF STORMS NOW LOCATED IN THE WESTERN PART OF WW 334...IS EXPECTED TO MAINTAIN A SOUTHWARD MOVEMENT INTO A STRONG SSWLY LLJ /35-45 KT PER AREA VADS/. RESIDUAL MODERATELY STRONG INSTABILITY /MUCAPE 2000-3000 J PER KG/ AND THE RELATIVELY SHALLOW NATURE OF AN OUTFLOW BOUNDARY /JUST BELOW 1 KM AGL PER DDC VAD/ THAT HAS REACHED FAR NORTH-CENTRAL TO NORTHWEST OK SUGGEST DAMAGING WINDS COULD PENETRATE TO THE SURFACE. FOR THESE FACTORS/REASONS...SOUTHERN PORTIONS OF WW 330 COULD BE EXTENDED IN TIME FOR THIS CONTINUED SEVERE THREAT. ..PETERS.. 07/06/2016 ...PLEASE SEE WWW.SPC.NOAA.GOV FOR GRAPHIC PRODUCT...

mesoscale_discussions.summary: OVERALL SEVERE-WEATHER THREAT...PRIMARILY OCCURRING AS LOCALLY STRONG TO SEVERE WIND GUSTS...IS EXPECTED TO CONTINUE DIMINISHING WITH SOUTHWARD EXTENT ACROSS NORTHWEST INDIANA THROUGH CENTRAL ILLINOIS TO EXTREME SOUTHEAST IA. ALTHOUGH STORMS WILL MOVE INTO AREAS OF THESE THREE STATES AND PERHAPS IN FAR NORTHEAST AND EAST-CENTRAL PARTS OF MO /SOUTH OF WW 333/...THE FURTHER DECELERATION OF THE LEADING BAND OF STORMS/OUTFLOW PRECLUDES THE NEED FOR A NEW SEVERE TSTM WATCH.
mesoscale_discussions.discussion: AT 0945Z...MOSAIC RADAR IMAGERY SHOWED AN EXTENSIVE BAND OF STORMS EXTENDING FROM NORTHWEST INDIANA TO FAR SOUTHEAST IA ALONG THE SOUTHERN EXTENT OF THE MCS DEVELOPING TO THE SOUTH/SOUTHEAST INTO THE MIDWEST/MID MS VALLEY REGION. A 25-30 KT LLJ HAS VEERED TO WESTERLY FROM EASTERN MO INTO THE OH VALLEY REGION...WHICH HAS RESULTED IN THIS JET BECOMING PARALLEL TO THE SOUTHWARD-MOVING BAND OF STORMS. THIS FACTOR AND TRENDS IN RECENT RADAR TIME-LAPSE OF THE EXTENSIVE BAND OF STORMS SUGGEST MOST OF THE ACTIVITY CONTINUES TO BECOME UNDERCUT AS THE ATTENDANT CONVECTIVE OUTFLOW MOVES AWAY FROM THE STRONGER STORMS. THIS PROCESS APPEARS TO BE SIMILAR TO AN ANAFRONT...WHILE RESIDUAL MUCAPE OF 1500-3000 J/KG SHOULD ALLOW FOR EPISODIC STRONGER STORM DEVELOPMENT WITH LOCALLY STRONG WIND GUSTS AND PERHAPS SOME HAIL. ..PETERS.. 07/06/2016 ...PLEASE SEE WWW.SPC.NOAA.GOV FOR GRAPHIC PRODUCT...

mesoscale_discussions.summary: THE OVERALL THREAT FOR SEVERE WEATHER TO OCCUR EARLY THIS MORNING CONTINUES TO DIMINISH WITH THE SOUTHEAST PORTION OF WW 334 HAVING THE GREATEST POTENTIAL THROUGH 12-13Z. IN THIS PORTION OF THE WATCH...WHICH INCLUDES MAINLY FAR SOUTHWEST MO AND ADJACENT COUNTIES IN EXTREME SOUTHEAST KS AND NORTHEAST OK...ISOLATED DAMAGING WINDS MAY OCCUR.
mesoscale_discussions.discussion: TRENDS IN IR SATELLITE IMAGERY SHOWED WARMING CLOUD TOPS ATTENDANT TO THE KS MCS. THE LEADING PORTION OF THIS COMPLEX MOVED INTO FAR SOUTHWEST MO BETWEEN 1030-1040Z WITH AN EAST-SOUTHEAST MOVEMENT AROUND 45 KT. DESPITE THIS FAST SPEED... SURFACE OBSERVATIONS HAVE REPORTED SUB-SEVERE GUSTS...SUGGESTING THE DEPTH OF THE STABILIZING BOUNDARY LAYER HAS BECOME GREAT ENOUGH TO LIMIT DOWNWARD MOMENTUM TRANSFER. A 30-40 KT SWLY LOW-LEVEL JET EXTENDING FROM THE SOUTHERN PLAINS INTO THIS MCS WILL SUPPORT FURTHER TSTM DEVELOPMENT...THOUGH THE AFOREMENTIONED BOUNDARY-LAYER STABILIZATION SUGGESTS THE SEVERE-WEATHER THREAT WILL CONTINUE TO DIMINISH...AS STORMS DEVELOP/SPREAD INTO SOUTHERN MO...NORTHEAST OK AND FAR NORTHERN AR. ..PETERS.. 07/06/2016 ...PLEASE SEE WWW.SPC.NOAA.GOV FOR GRAPHIC PRODUCT...
